This confirms my own grep. The two `scripts/manifest-parts/*.ts` files only contain `PlanId` inside string literals (manifest signature documentation), not as actual TypeScript type syntax — no import of `PlanId`, no real type annotation/argument/Record key. Per the task's criteria (type annotation, type argument, Record key position, or import), these don't qualify and are excluded, matching the "read plan's numbers through helpers" exclusion spirit — they don't name the type in code.

All other 19 files genuinely import/annotate/use `PlanId` as a type.
